$comment: Agent tasks for script/docs-agent-benchmark.ts. Each task is a small repository and a request phrased the way a person asks a coding agent. checks are regexes on the files after the run: every check needs one file whose path matches `file` (an empty `file` matches any file) and whose content matches `pattern`. They were checked against docs.sentry.io in November 2026.

from celery import Celery

os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "mysite.settings")

app = Celery("mysite")
app.config_from_object("django.conf:settings", namespace="CELERY")
app.autodiscover_tasks()

  use Mix.Project

  def project do
    [app: :worker, version: "0.1.0", elixir: "~> 1.17", deps: deps()]
  end

  defp deps do
    [
      {:oban, "~> 2.18"},
      {:sentry, "~> 11.0"},
      {:jason, "~> 1.4"}
    ]
  end
end
files.config/config.exs:
import Config

config :worker, Oban,
  repo: Worker.Repo,
  queues: [default: 10],
  plugins: [{Oban.Plugins.Cron, crontab: [{"0 6 * * *", Worker.DailyReport}]}]

config :sentry,
  dsn: System.get_env("SENTRY_DSN"),
  environment_name: config_env()
